{{nihongo|'''Zōni'''|雑煮 or ぞうに}}, often with the [[Honorific speech in Japanese|honorific]] "o-" as ''o-zōni'', is a Japanese [[soup]] containing ''[[Mochi (food)|mochi]]'' rice cakes.<ref name="dijitaru">{{cite encyclopedia | encyclopedia = Dijitaru daijisen | title = 美保湾 (Miho-wan) | url = http://rekishi.jkn21.com/ | access-date = 2012-05-20 | year = 2012 | publisher = Shogakukan | location = Tokyo | language = ja | archive-date = 2007-08-25 | archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20070825113418/http://rekishi.jkn21.com/ | url-status = dead }}</ref> The dish is strongly associated with the [[Japanese New Year]] and its tradition of ''[[osechi]]'' ceremonial foods. The preparation of zōni varies both by household and region.<ref name="dijitaru"/>
